visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: rounded landscape photo (or portrait) filling the right column
visualCharacteristics.structure: two equal columns per row: text (heading, paragraphs, bulleted list, optional link) beside a photo; rows separated by thin rules
visualCharacteristics.columns: 2 (50/50) on desktop, stacked text-then-image on mobile

contentPattern: One row per text | image pair: cell 1 heading + paragraphs + bulleted list (optional link), cell 2 image. Repeated as separate rows separated by thin rules (in-store technology x6, collection x3); our-artwork 'About The Artist' uses the same pattern with a portrait.
